title: MissionObjective
description: One NASA Moon-to-Mars objective as the ARL ladder reads it (ADR-0002 D1). Mirrors Analog.Readiness.Objective: required scored dimensions, the not-testable-on-Earth list, and whether it is rateable. The dimension mapping is our interpretation of NASA's text, not NASA's.

objectiveId.description: Moon to Mars Objectives code, e.g. OP-5LM. The L/M/LM suffix is NASA's (lunar, Martian or both).

body.description: Target body this row rates. An LM objective gets one row per body.

title.description: Shortened objective text (ours). The verbatim text is in the source PDF.

earthTestableComponent.description: One sentence: the part of the objective a field test on Earth can rehearse.

rateable.description: False when the objective's main content can't be tested on Earth. Such rows get no ARL at all (Lean S6g).

requiredDimensions.description: Scored dimensions every per-dimension gate must pass. Same enum as site.schema.json.

status.description: proposed = our interpretation, not yet reviewed by a subject expert.

sources.description: Repo docs or URLs the mapping comes from.

envelopeId.description: envelope.schema.json envelopeId giving the tolerance per required dimension. null = no envelope yet, so gate 2 can only be unknown.

why.description: Plain-English reason this part can't be rehearsed on Earth.

notTestableOnEarth.description: Published next to the level, never changes it (Lean S6f).

recordedIn.description: Where the probe is recorded, e.g. a research doc or data/snapshots path.
